83-type signature corresponding to InsDel2b (C_ID2)

Note

InsDel2a and 2c 89-type and 476-type extractions collapse to an 83-type signature close to C_ID2. InsDel2b extractions have more insertions of a single T in long poly-T contexts, which are absent from C_ID2, as well as some single-T deletions in stretches of 4 and 5 T’s, which are also absent from C_ID2.

These Sankey diagrams show how the 476-type mutation categories are redistributed to 83-type categories using bipartite matching. We only show the diagrams for insertions or deletions of > 1 base because it is for these indels that 476-type categories map to > 1 83-type category.
